# SPDX License Index

This index categorizes all open-source licenses present across the AtlasCAD ecosystem according to standard SPDX identifiers.

## Permissive Licenses (Tier A)
- `Apache-2.0`: Apache License 2.0 (truck, Manifold, MuJoCo)
- `MIT`: MIT License (caddy, internal tooling)
- `BSD-3-Clause`: 3-Clause BSD License (pandapower, OpenDSS, Cantera, RDKit, EnergyPlus, OpenSees)
- `CC0-1.0`: Creative Commons Zero Public Domain (EPANET, EPA SWMM, MODFLOW)
- `NOSA-1.3`: NASA Open Source Agreement 1.3 (OpenVSP)

## Weak Copyleft Licenses (Tier B)
- `LGPL-2.1-only`: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 (SU2, JSBSim)
- `LGPL-2.1-only WITH OCCT-exception-1.0`: Open CASCADE Technology Public License exception
- `LGPL-3.0-only`: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (IfcOpenShell)

## Strong Copyleft Licenses (Tier C - Process Isolated)
- `GPL-2.0-only`: GNU General Public License v2.0 (CalculiX)
- `GPL-2.0-or-later`: GNU General Public License v2.0 or later (Gmsh)
- `GPL-3.0-only`: GNU General Public License v3.0 (OpenFOAM, DWSIM, SolveSpace)
- `GPL-3.0-or-later`: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later (KiCad)
